english.title: Premises user - temporary event notice - knowingly allow children in premises between 2400 and 0500 hours - Licensing
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being the user of premises, namely **(..SPECIFY THE PREMISES AND LOCATION..), in respect of which a temporary event notice was in effect in relation to a permitted temporary activity, allowed an unaccompanied child to be on the premises between the hours of midnight and 5 am when they were open exclusively or primarily for the supply of alcohol for consumption there
english.legislation: Contrary to section 145(1)(b), (3)(d) and (9) of the Licensing Act 2003.
